Messages.Author: nekojosh
Messages.Body:
Hi i have a doubt, for cards like Quicken Sight that list more than one discipline for its effects does it means that the vampire need to have both disciplines to play it or just one of the two?

Quicken Sight
Reaction

Auspex & Celerity

aus cel +1 intercept, with an optional maneuver in the resulting combat if this vampire successfully blocks.
AUS CEL As above, but with +2 intercept.

Messages.Author: Lönkka
Messages.Body:
> nekojosh wrote:
> does it means that the vampire need to have both disciplines to play it or just one of the two?
>
Both.

These cards tend to have more powerful effects thus the prerequisites for playing them are higher.

Finnish  Politics!
